intent: B4 of the final-release programme: the analytics taxonomy extended once. ANALYTICS_EVENT_TYPES gains research.*, composer.*, profile.*, toolset.saved, config.saved, memory.configured, memory.retained, template.saved, mission.cancelled, script.*, artifact.saved, backup.taken, credential.added, model.added and help.opened, each emitted only after its write succeeds and only from a write path; categories updated; personality.changed re-homed to the Identity tab's write path (D86 noted uncertain); Completionist reads a curated list; RawMetrics gains per-type counters and the store facts the quest evaluator reads.

reasons.evidence: twenty-six emit sites across the API and four lib modules; no schema change, no public-route delta

programme: B4, depends on B1 (T-0095). One emit-site test per type; the categories map is exhaustive by type.
invariants: I1 The taxonomy is one tuple of forty, each type in exactly one of nine categories, each category painted with a declared neon token; an unmapped string is null, never a guess.

I2 An event is a claim that the table holds the outcome: every emit sits after the write it reports and never before it, and a write that throws, is refused, or answers a failure leaves no event. The oracle holds each of the twenty-six sites to that with a failure at or after the write, not a validation case an early emit would slip past.

I3 Only a write path emits. A read that shares the verb (the Hindsight recall, a directive created through the same POST switch) records nothing; a gate is approved only when accepted; a batch push or pull is one row counting what crossed, written only when something did.
I4 SOUL.md is the personality: the managed-file PUT records personality.changed for the soul key alone, so the Identity tab of B9 inherits the Shapeshifter ledger through the door it will use.

I5 Completionist is measured from the ledger against COMPLETIONIST_EVENT_TYPES: a type counts once recorded at all, a failure never counts, a type nothing emits yet is not on the list, and the target and the description are that list's length rather than a literal.

I6 RawMetrics carries eventCounts for every type (zero when never recorded) and the store facts (named profiles, models, credentials, workflows, and a memory provider the operator saved rather than inherited from the seed); computeDashboard() returns the stats and the raw metrics from one read, and a database without the newer tables reads zeros, not errors.
commits: 1d554b15 the oracle alone (7 suites, 128 tests, measured red: 56 failing, 12 on the taxonomy, Completionist and the stats reader, 44 on expect(recordEvent).toHaveBeenCalledWith with zero calls after the route's success was asserted green); da54b097 the implementation (the tuple, the entity tuple, the curated list, nine categories, the ledger and facts in the stats reader, twenty-six emit sites, three fixtures amended, the docs); 47f1bec6 the sharpened Hindsight oracle the sweep asked for.
deviation: (1) Nine categories over six neon tokens: three pairs share a colour (Workflows with Config, Research with Chat, Help with Sessions) and are placed apart in the series order so no two adjacent bands of the stacked area read as one. The plan did not say what to paint the new rows with; declaring new tokens for three small categories was judged the wrong trade against the token gate, and the Insights legend names every row. (2) The curated list is expressed as the tuple minus two named exclusions (the three types with no emitter until B6, B14 and B16; the three failure types) rather than as a hand-copied list, so the batch that lands an emitter removes one name and the list grows by itself. (3) The engine records composer.run_failed at its backstop and broken-graph failures (the total-steps cap, no start node, no current node, node missing) as well as the four applyNext sites the plan named, because a run that ended is a run that ended whichever guard ended it; the oracle covers the applyNext sites and the sweep the loop cap. (4) The Composer's own cancel records nothing: the plan names no composer.run_cancelled and adding a type outside the decided twenty-six was not this batch's call. (5) A batch push or pull counts the root agent among the profiles that crossed and never the skills; the oracle's fixtures were built so the expected count is the same under either reading, and the record says which one the code takes. (6) memoryConfigured means active, enabled and updated_at <> created_at, the repository's own rule for telling a saved provider from the seeded guess (T-0077), because the migration seeds an active Hindsight row on every install and a guess is not a configuration.
verification: Gate b4 on the implementation tree by exit code: lint 0 (agent-files, doc-links, derived views, read-only guards, icon-button names, form-control names, design-lint 0 baselined, contrast, coverage floors, eslint, typecheck:tests), tsc 0, knip 0, canary OK (no stable surface moved: no route, schema, migration or seed changed), build 0, Playwright 128 passed, 0 failed, 8 skipped; jest 1 on 4279, one older fixture (achievements-showcase) that cast a two-field object to RawMetrics and had no ledger to read. The fixture gained eventCounts and the full suite was re-run on the committed tree da54b097: 481 suites, 4279 tests, 0 failing. The B4 suites alone: 7 suites, 129 tests after the sharpening, all green.
mutation: 43 mutants against the committed tree (da54b097), 42 killed on the first pass and the survivor killed on the second (47f1bec6): a type dropped from the tuple, the not-yet-emitted and failure exclusions emptied, a research type filed under missions, the Help category missing, an undeclared colour, Completionist back on a literal 14, crediting zero counts, counting every type, reading distinct types, an empty ledger, a profiles count of zero, workflows counted from models, the seeded memory guess counted as configured, enabled ignored, getDashboardStats detached from the same read, the research start unrecorded, the research outcome emitted before the terminal row, always completed, a rejected Composer run read as completed, the loop cap silent, a rejected gate approved, the approval emitted before it was recorded, the workflow replace emitted before the replace, the profile emitted before the push, a failed push or pull recorded, an all-failed batch recorded, a batch counting failures, the toolset emitted before the guard, AGENTS.md recorded as a personality, SOUL.md emitted before the push, config emitted before the file write, memory emitted before the null guard, a template emitted before the save, a cancel emitted before the not-found guard, a script save or run emitted before its guard, a cron emitted before the crontab write was checked, the artifact unrecorded, a credential emitted before the env write, a model emitted before the config sync. The survivor, memory.retained emitted after every Hindsight POST action, lived because the oracle's non-retain case was the GET recall, which never reaches that switch; a directive created through the same POST now answers 200 and records nothing, and the mutant dies.
proof: Isolated instance (production build of da54b097 from the gate, e2e-b1 data dir, mock-hermes 8747, mock-hindsight 9277), four scenes, 24 checks, all PASS on the first run: (1) seven real writes through the API (an artifact, a template, a model, a script, the memory provider, a retained memory, a research run) each answer success and each adds exactly one row of its type to GET /api/analytics, and the research run's outcome (completed, against the mock) reaches the ledger from the background job within the thirty seconds allowed; (2) GET /api/stats measures Completionist against 34 with the number in its description, and its current (16) equals the curated types the ledger holds; (3) GET /api/analytics/insights carries the nine category keys in order and today's bands count the config, research and workflows writes; (4) /results/insights at 1280x720 names Research and Workflows beside Config and Missions, the ring listing all nine. Screenshot: scratchpad walk-b4/insights-1280x720.png.
harness_amendments: Three older fixtures learned the two new RawMetrics fields (stats-derive, agent-progression, achievements-showcase); stats-derive's Completionist row reads one event of each curated type where it read distinctEventTypes: 14; the facts oracle's four store counts became four different numbers (2, 3, 1, 4) so a count read from the wrong table shows, which the sweep confirmed. The emit-site suites were written and refuted by a workflow of eleven agents before the oracle commit: the skeptics caught a throwing double leaking across tests through clearAllMocks, a pauseAll branch reaching the real file system for its sidecar, and a batch-count fixture that assumed the root counted; each was repaired before the red was measured.
deferred: research.cancelled's emitter arrives with the Research cancel (B14), backup.taken with Settings > System backups (B6), help.opened with the Help section (B16); each removes its name from NOT_YET_EMITTED and joins the curated list. The quest evaluator that reads eventCounts and facts is B17. The old personality route keeps its emitter until B9 deletes the route. docs/ANALYTICS.md's taxonomy table becomes a generated block in B15.
